findings.message: `proj.ga4.events_*` matches every shard, but the query doesn't filter on `_TABLE_SUFFIX`, so it reads all of them (750 GB in all). The filter on `event_timestamp` doesn't limit which shards are read.
findings.fix: Add a filter on `_TABLE_SUFFIX`, for example `_TABLE_SUFFIX >= FORMAT_DATE('%Y%m%d', DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY))`, or name fewer shards with a longer prefix.

findings.message: The query would bill 378.6 GB, at or over the warn threshold of 100 GiB.
findings.fix: Read less: filter on the partition column, or select only the columns you need. If the scan is intended, a person can raise the threshold in scanisaur.yaml.
